title: Group Anagrams
statement_short: Given an array of strings strs, group the anagrams together in any order. An anagram is a word formed by rearranging the letters of another word using all original letters exactly once.
constraints: 1 <= strs.length <= 10^4, 0 <= strs[i].length <= 100, strs[i] consists of lowercase English letters
hint: Array length up to 10^4 requires O(N \* K) time by hashing character frequency tuple keys.
why_not: Right: HashMap / Hash Set maps character count keys (or sorted strings) to lists of anagrams in O(N \* K) time. Not Trie: Prefix trees organize prefix sequences rather than grouping unordered character counts into hash buckets. Not Sorting: Sorting each word individually takes O(N \* K log K) time, which is slightly slower than tuple key counting. Not Two Pointers: Scanning pointer pairs cannot group arbitrary string buckets across an unsorted list.
complexity: O(N \* K) time, O(N \* K) space
